title: FatGUI
body:
# **FatGUI** 

This resource pack adds a more beautiful Minecraft GUI

![gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e641a60536f5a2f1e659a29e96cf02cf4d2c195.jpeg)

This resource pack overhauls the default graphical user interface (GUI) of Minecraft, giving it a more modern, sleek, and visually appealing design. It’s perfect for players who are looking for stylish and functional changes to the game's interface while retaining its usability and familiar layout.
